description: This file defines the EducationService class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It provides methods for managing Education entities, including CRUD operations, searching, and validation. It interacts with the EducationDao for data persistence and uses other DTOs and entity classes.

classes.name: EducationService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic and operations related to Education entities, including saving, fetching, searching, deleting, and validation.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Saves an Education object, either creating a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: getEducationDao
methods.description: Returns the associated EducationDao object, instantiating it if not already set.

methods.name: setEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EducationDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its ID.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Returns a list of Education entities matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Education records matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Deletes Education records given an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education name already exists in the database, case-insensitive.
